name: canyon_600
doc: Truce Canyon, 600 A.D.: Crono gets up by the Gate (loc 071), walks west and wins the Blue Imp ambush (A mashed), into loc 070: up the east ladder, over the bridge, a second ambush (Blue Imps, won), across the plateau, down the west ladder and out of the canyon's south edge onto the 600 A.D. overworld (loc 1F1).
